1.why: Math is challenging but I can handle it with effort and practice, though I often feel uncertain about my abilities.

2.why: I believe I have some ability in math but sometimes doubt my competence when facing complex problems.

3.why: Learning math requires focus and I find some concepts difficult, yet I can grasp them with time.

4.why: I think I could succeed in future math courses if I put in the work, though I am not overly confident.

5.why: Understanding math content is manageable for me, especially with chemistry and maths as my favorite subjects.

6.why: Getting an A is possible but I often worry about making mistakes and not performing to my potential.

7.why: I can do basic math but advanced calculations sometimes make me anxious about my performance in class.

8.why: Tests create significant anxiety for me and I worry about not performing well under pressure.

9.why: Preparing for tests makes me tense and anxious even though I know the material.

10.why: Taking tests is stressful and I feel nervous throughout the exam process.

11.why: I worry about not getting an A and fear it reflects poorly on my capabilities.

12.why: Getting a good grade is important but I am anxious about my performance and preparation.

13.why: I can feel some confidence in tests but anxiety often undermines my performance during exams.

14.why: I believe I can do well generally but test anxiety sometimes prevents me from showing my true ability.

15.why: Doing math homework is stressful for me and I often dread starting assignments.

16.why: Using math outside school makes me nervous and I worry about making mistakes in real situations.

17.why: I can use math in daily life but lack confidence when the situation requires complex calculations.

18.why: I worry about my future career and whether I can use mathematics effectively when needed.

19.why: Understanding math concepts sometimes feels overwhelming and I worry about not grasping the material.

20.why: Learning math well is a concern for me and I worry about my ability to keep up.

21.why: Listening to instructors is manageable but I feel some stress during math classes.

22.why: I think I could use math in my career but anxiety makes me doubt my long-term competence.

23.why: I worry I don't know enough to succeed in future courses and feel inadequate about my knowledge.

24.why: Giving wrong answers in class terrifies me and I fear judgment from peers and instructors.

25.why: I can ask questions but only when I am sure and the situation is not too high pressure.

26.why: Asking questions in class makes me nervous and I worry about looking foolish to others.

27.why: Completing assignments is within my ability but I worry about meeting all the requirements.

28.why: I worry I cannot finish every assignment and it adds to my overall mathematics anxiety.
